blind.description: A stylized ornate wooden round pedestal table. It features a circular thick tabletop with inlaid marquetry patterns along the border and in the center. The top rests on a turned central pedestal column, supported by a four-legged base with carved animal claw feet and green-and-gold painted side panels. The geometry is solid, continuous, and clean, standing firmly on its four claw feet without an extra plinth.
blind.from_above: A circular tabletop composed of radial wood segments with a decorative lighter wood inlaid ring around the perimeter and an intricate heraldic or floral inlaid crest in the center.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 ft tall (under half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 ft in diameter.

notes: base has four claw feet branching from pedestal rather than three
